disposition_reason: Table 3 prints per-sample zinc, copper, iron, manganese, cadmium and lead in 15 raw milk samples from vendors and dairy shops across Peshawar; the text prints means and ranges.

study.design: Cross-sectional survey of raw milk from street vendors and dairy shops
study.origin: Peshawar city, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan (animal species not stated)
study.market: local street vendors and dairy shops at 15 locations, Peshawar
study.method: 50 mL milk dried at 70 C for 72 h; 2 g dry ashed at 500 C, dissolved in HCl; flame AAS (AA-6300) with deuterium background correction; results reported per litre
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or LOD reported

unresolved: Printed year 2021 (Int J Econ Environ Geol 12(1): 53-59); manifest gives 2024.
Results are per litre although the digestion used 2 g of dried milk; the conversion is not explained.
Lead (mean 1.1162 mg/L) and cadmium (0.1865 mg/L) are orders of magnitude above typical milk levels; no QA is reported.
Milk species not stated; average 31.1% added water reported (adulteration).
Zn text range minimum (0.4405) conflicts with Table 3 M4 (0.0896).
